literal_meaning: চন্দ্র দ্বারা আঘাতপ্রাপ্ত (struck by the moon)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চন্দ্রাহতের মতো চিৎকার করতে লাগল।
এই খবরে সবাই চন্দ্রাহত হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He started screaming like he was moonstruck.
The news left everyone acting insane.
history: This term is an adaptation in Bengali mimicking the English words 'moonstruck' and 'lunatic', which derive from beliefs about the moon's influence on human behavior.
note: Borrowed concept from English folklore regarding lunar effects on madness.
